content: {"tax_bps":100,"endowment_share":30,"locker_share":25,"buyback_burn":2,"minutes":"Sell pressure dominates (73.7 NEAR sold vs 26.1 bought), so I cut the tax from 125 to 100 bps to lower friction and invite volume back — this answers the two tax petitions. locker_share is already at the constitutional maximum of 25, so holder-154's request cannot be granted further; lockers remain well paid relative to the endowment.
